---
# ! HOW TO USE: copy and paste this template into your folder (lastname-firstname) and rename it into `index.qmd`.
title: Full name
description: Roles
# use a square photo (same width and height) so it displays consistently with everyone else's card, with no empty margins or cropping
image: avatar.webp

last: Last name
first: First name
email: Your email of contact

# select one of the following groups. introduce it as a string (surrounded by ""), as this allow to perform glob operations.  
people_group: "pi | research_scientist | postdoc | visitor | phd | student | alumni"

# education is shown as a HTML list where each title is an element of the list. the education title follows the structure "<PhD|MS|BS> in <X> - University <X>, <year>".
# just modify the following template with your data
education: |
  <ul>
    <li><strong>PhD in Statistics</strong> - Universitat Politècnica de València, 2014</li>
    <li><strong>BS in Mathematics & Statistics</strong> - Universitat Politècnica de València, 2001</li>
  </ul>

# education_card is a short version of "education" shown on the compact card in the group listing (the full list above is only used on this page). Wrap the degree title itself in "<strong>...</strong>" so it shows up bold. Only list degrees you already hold — leave out anything still "in progress". Separate multiple degrees with " <br> ". If you don't have a finished degree yet, delete this field entirely.
education_card: "<strong>BS in Mathematics & Statistics</strong>, Universitat Politècnica de València, 2001"
affiliation: Your affiliation

# we use the "trestles" template for the "about" div. 
about:
  template: trestles
  image-shape: round

  # remove the links fields that are unnecessary
  links: 
    - icon: envelope-fill
      href: mailto:example@email.com

    - icon: globe2
      href: https://www.example-website.com
    
    - icon: linkedin
      href: https://www.linkedin.com/in/example-profile.com
    
    - icon: github
      href: https://github.com/example-profile.com
    
    - text: '<i class="ai ai-google-scholar-square"></i>'
      href: https://github.com/example-scholar.com
    
    - text: '<i class="ai ai-orcid"></i>'
      href: https://orcid.org/example-orcid.com

layout: full
---
